name: Resell Ledger AI Research & Listing Automation

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Entry point. App POSTs {item_id, photo_url, name, seller_condition, missing_items, seller_notes} here.

nodes.name: Verify Webhook Secret
nodes.notes: Rejects requests whose x-webhook-secret header does not match WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Respond Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 401 immediately when the webhook secret does not match. Dead end.

nodes.name: Set Variables
nodes.notes: Normalizes incoming webhook fields into clean, null-safe variables for the rest of the workflow.

nodes.name: Mark Processing in Supabase
nodes.notes: Flips the listing row to ai_status=processing so the app UI shows a spinner.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Responds to the app within ~1-2s so it never times out. Everything after this runs async.

nodes.name: AI: Image Recognition
nodes.notes: Vision model identifies brand/model/category from the item photo. Must use AI_MODEL_VISION.

nodes.name: Parse Image Recognition
nodes.notes: Strips code fences and safely parses the vision model's JSON response, with a fallback on parse failure.

nodes.name: Brave Search 1: Product Identification
nodes.notes: Web search to corroborate/refine the vision model's product identification.

nodes.name: Wait 1s (1)
nodes.notes: Respects Brave Search free-tier rate limit of 1 req/sec.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $('Parse Image Recognition').item.json.brand }} {{ $('Parse Image Recognition').item.json.model }} specifications dimensions weight features full specs

nodes.name: Brave Search 2: Specifications
nodes.notes: Web search for detailed specs, dimensions and features.

nodes.name: Wait 1s (2)
nodes.notes: Respects Brave Search free-tier rate limit of 1 req/sec.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $('Parse Image Recognition').item.json.identified_product_name }} retail price MSRP new buy 2024

nodes.name: Brave Search 3: Retail Price
nodes.notes: Web search for original/current retail price (MSRP).

nodes.name: AI: Product Research Synthesis
nodes.notes: Synthesizes image analysis + web search results into a full product profile. Uses AI_MODEL_RESEARCH.

nodes.name: Parse Product Research
nodes.notes: Safely parses the product research JSON, falling back to the image-recognition data on parse failure.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $('Parse Product Research').item.json.comparable_search_query }} sold price {{ $('Set Variables').item.json.seller_condition }} ebay completed listings

nodes.name: Brave Search 4: eBay Sold Prices
nodes.notes: Web search for eBay sold/completed listing prices at this condition tier.

nodes.name: Wait 1s (3)
nodes.notes: Respects Brave Search free-tier rate limit of 1 req/sec.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $('Parse Product Research').item.json.comparable_search_query }} used price {{ $('Set Variables').item.json.seller_condition }} facebook marketplace craigslist offerup 2024 2025

nodes.name: Brave Search 5: Used Market Prices
nodes.notes: Web search for used market pricing across FB Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp.

nodes.name: Wait 1s (4)
nodes.notes: Respects Brave Search free-tier rate limit of 1 req/sec.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $('Parse Product Research').item.json.comparable_search_query }} resale value price guide {{ $('Set Variables').item.json.seller_condition }} worth

nodes.name: Brave Search 6: Price Guide / Resale Value
nodes.notes: Web search for resale price guides / worth estimates.

nodes.name: eBay: Get OAuth Token
nodes.notes: Fetches an eBay OAuth token via client_credentials. NOT wired to the global error handler — if eBay API access isn't approved yet, this node fails softly (onError=continueRegularOutput) and the pipeline proceeds using Brave Search data only.

nodes.name: eBay: Browse API Search
nodes.notes: Live eBay listing search for pricing comps. Soft-fails (onError=continueRegularOutput) on missing token/API access so downstream valuation just treats itemSummaries as unavailable.

nodes.name: AI: Valuation Analysis
nodes.notes: Turns market research + eBay comps into concrete pricing recommendations. Uses AI_MODEL_VALUATION.

nodes.name: Parse Valuation
nodes.notes: Safely parses the valuation JSON, with a null-safe fallback on parse failure.

PRODUCT PROFILE: ${JSON.stringify($('Parse Product Research').item.json)} VALUATION DATA: ${JSON.stringify($('Parse Valuation').item.json)} SELLER-PROVIDED DETAILS: - Stated Condition: ${$('Set Variables').item.json.seller_condition} - Missing Items: ${$('Set Variables').item.json.missing_items} - Seller Notes: ${$('Set Variables').item.json.seller_notes || 'None'} EBAY LISTING REQUIREMENTS & STANDARDS: TITLE (Max 80 characters): - Include: Brand, Model/Model Number, key descriptor, condition signal if space allows - Optimize for eBay Cassini search (most-searched terms first) - No symbols like !, $, @, all-caps words - Example format: 'Sony PlayStation 4 Pro 1TB Gaming Console CUH-7215B Good' SUBTITLE (Max 55 characters, optional but recommended): - Add detail that didn't fit in title - Highlight best feature or bundle detail CONDITION MAPPING (use exact eBay tier names): - Seller 'New' → eBay 'New' - Seller 'Like New' → eBay 'Like New' - Seller 'Good' → eBay 'Good' - Seller 'Fair' → eBay 'Acceptable' - Seller 'Poor' → eBay 'For Parts or Not Working' CONDITION DESCRIPTION (Max 1000 characters): - Must be honest and specific about actual state - Mention all defects, wear, missing items - Include what IS included - Avoid vague terms like 'shows normal wear' DESCRIPTION (Full HTML, use eBay-compatible HTML only): - Use: ,

nodes.name: AI: eBay Listing Builder
nodes.notes: Writes the eBay-standard title/description/item specifics/pricing. Uses AI_MODEL_WRITER.

nodes.name: Parse eBay Listing
nodes.notes: Safely parses the eBay listing JSON, with a conservative fallback listing on parse failure.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: $env['AI_MODEL_WRITER_' + $env.AI_PROVIDER],
  max_tokens: 3000,
  temperature: 0.4,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are an expert at writing Facebook Marketplace listings that generate fast responses and serious buyers. You know that FB Marketplace shoppers are local, value-focused, and scan quickly — they want to know what it is, what shape it's in, and what you want for it. Your listings are honest, conversational, and highlight value without being salesy. Always respond in raw, valid JSON only."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content: `Create a complete Facebook Marketplace listing for this item.

PRODUCT PROFILE:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Product Research').item.json)}

VALUATION DATA:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Valuation').item.json)}

SELLER-PROVIDED DETAILS:
- Stated Condition: ${$('Set Variables').item.json.seller_condition}
- Missing Items: ${$('Set Variables').item.json.missing_items}
- Seller Notes: ${$('Set Variables').item.json.seller_notes || 'None'}

FACEBOOK MARKETPLACE REQUIREMENTS & STANDARDS:

TITLE (Max 100 characters):
- Clear and descriptive — what it is, brand and model
- Local buyer friendly — no jargon, no eBay-style keyword stuffing
- Examples: 'Sony PS4 Pro 1TB — Good Condition, No Remote', 'KitchenAid Stand Mixer — Like New'

PRICE:
- Use price_sell_fast_usd — FB Marketplace buyers expect to negotiate, so this is your starting ask
- Note: list the price_sell_fast_usd as the asking price

DESCRIPTION (Plain text only — NO HTML):
- Conversational and friendly, not corporate
- Be upfront about condition and missing items (builds trust, reduces ghosting)
- Structure:
  1. What it is (1 sentence — assume they didn't read the title)
  2. Condition details (honest, matter-of-fact)
  3. What's included / what's missing (be specific)
  4. Why it's priced the way it is (optional, 1 sentence — e.g. 'priced to move')
  5. 'DM me with any questions!' closing
- Tone: friendly neighbor selling stuff, not a storefront
- Length: 100-300 words. Buyers on mobile skim — don't write a novel.

HASHTAGS: 5-8 relevant hashtags (FB Marketplace supports them, buyers sometimes search)

CATEGORY: Suggest the correct Facebook Marketplace category

Return ONLY this exact JSON:
{
  "fb_title": "Max 100 char title",
  "fb_price": "number (the asking price)",
  "fb_description": "Full plain text Facebook Marketplace post",
  "fb_category": "Facebook Marketplace category name",
  "fb_hashtags": ["#tag1", "#tag2", "#tag3"],
  "fb_seller_tips": ["2-3 actionable tips for selling this item on Facebook Marketplace"]
}`
    }
  ]
}) }}

nodes.name: AI: Facebook Marketplace Post Builder
nodes.notes: Writes the casual, conversion-optimized Facebook Marketplace post. Uses AI_MODEL_WRITER.

nodes.name: Parse Facebook Post
nodes.notes: Safely parses the Facebook Marketplace post JSON, with a fallback post on parse failure.

nodes.name: Save All Results to Supabase
nodes.notes: Writes every AI result to the listings row and flips ai_status=complete, which fires Supabase Realtime to the app. Column names are suggestions — adjust to match your actual schema.

nodes.name: Workflow Complete
nodes.notes: End of the happy path. The app's Supabase Realtime subscription picks up ai_status=complete.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ai_status: "failed", error_step: $prevNode.name, error_message: ($json.error && $json.error.message) ? $json.error.message : ($json.message ?? "Workflow step failed"), processing_completed_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Mark Failed in Supabase
nodes.notes: Shared error handler. Every ⚠️ node's error output lands here — marks the row failed with the step name and error message so the app can surface it.

nodes.name: Webhook Notify Configured?
nodes.notes: Only fires the webhook notification if ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK is configured.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: "workflow_failed", item_id: $('Set Variables').item.json.item_id, step_failed: $prevNode.name, error: ($json.error && $json.error.message) ? $json.error.message : "Unknown error", photo_url: $('Set Variables').item.json.photo_url, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Notify via Webhook
nodes.notes: POSTs a failure event to the app's own error-notification endpoint.

nodes.name: Email Notify Configured?
nodes.notes: Only fires the email notification if ERROR_NOTIFY_EMAIL is configured.

parameters.subject: =⚠️ Resell AI Workflow Failed — Item {{ $('Set Variables').item.json.item_id }}

nodes.name: Notify via Email
nodes.notes: Sends a plain-text failure alert email. After import, select/create your SMTP credential on this node (n8n Settings → Credentials) — not env-var driven since n8n credentials aren't expression-capable.

nodes.name: Build eBay Auth Header
nodes.notes: Precomputes the eBay Basic Auth header string. Must be a Code node -- Buffer is unavailable inside n8n's {{ }} expression sandbox.

nodes.name: Fetch Seller Comparable
nodes.notes: Best-effort raw fetch of a seller-provided comparable listing URL, if given. Not wired to the global error handler -- soft-fails (blank/unreachable URL) and Valuation just proceeds without it.
